Election Notices

     *             *             *            *             *   

 Link below for ballot


ATTENTION TOWN OF NEW LONDON VOTERS

In preparation of the upcoming NH State Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 the Supervisors of the Checklist will hold a public session on Monday, October 26, 2026, between 5:00 and 5:30 pm at the New London Town Offices, 375 Main Street to accept voter registration applications as well as to make additions and corrections to the Checklist and for anyone wishing to change their party affiliation.

No additions or corrections shall be made to the checklist after this session until Election Day November 3, 2026.

In order to register in NH, you need to prove identity, age, domicile and citizenship. For more information on acceptable documents visit, https://www.sos.nh.gov/elections/register-vote

NOTE: A NH REAL ID complaint driver’s license is NOT proof of US Citizenship in NH.

If your name has legally changed, for example through Marriage, Divorce, Adoption, or a court-appointed name change, you must present proof of your legal name change to show both your prior name as it appears on your proof of citizenship document and your current legal name as it appears on the Voter Registration Application.

Supervisors: Celeste Cook, Carolyn Fraley, Linda Jackman

 Residents of New London
(which includes Elkins village)
who will be 18 years of age or older on Election Day & a United States Citizen may register to vote at the Town Clerk's office before an election or at the polls on Election Day. 

In order to register, residents must be able to prove identity, age, residency and citizenship.  More information on how to register to vote can be found at the following link: 
Registering to Vote in NH
